description: Returns whether the connected organisation’s automated work is charged in Lightbringer credits, and if so the current balance, whether credit-consuming work is refused at zero, and what a patent import and a public patent search cost this user (0 when they are free). State disabled, internal or exempt means no credits are charged and the other fields are null; exhausted means the balance is spent. Paid automated analysis, such as the clarity feedback analysis, is charged by model usage rather than a fixed price.
name: get_credits
title: Get credits
